notes: School of Music official Music - Bachelor of Music - Strings Four Year Academic Plan. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out (only the major is audited).

MUSC229 (large ensemble), MUSC129 (small ensemble) and MUSC099 (recital attendance) are repeatable 1-credit courses, entered multiple times per the plan's own '(1 cr. x N semesters)' legend lines; see the program's reviewNotes.

The '1 semester of 400-level music history elective' generic slot is filled with MUSC460, and the '3-5 credits of music electives' slot with MUSC434, both from the Academic Catalog's approved MUSC course list (the source names no specific course for either).
